about.title: About Ledgerment
text: We’re a unique blend of finance experts, digital innovators, and seasoned entrepreneurs & small business owners. We understand the challenges of growing a business because we’ve been there ourselves. Our lived experience now helps us transform the way small businesses manage their finances, making accounting effortless, efficient, and stress-free.
Ledgerment’s roots run deep, from a family farm in South Africa to the heart of Houston’s business community.

Growing up in a small business environment, Paul learned the value of dedication and community principles that form the foundation of Ledgerment. Kim’s background in startups adds a dynamic understanding of the challenges faced by growing businesses.
